verdict.rationale: Raygun documents native repo integrations with GitHub, Bitbucket and GitLab (raygun-docs-2). It also tracks deployments to spot regressions (raygun-docs-31) and shows code snippets from source via source maps (raygun-docs-42). However, the specific behaviors the story asks for are not evidenced. Missing for 10: suspect-commit attribution on issues, code-owner assignment, linking from a stack frame to the exact line on the default branch, and any independent or hands-on corroboration of the repo integration.
